core-unity-soutions-jsbcjn.about_description:
1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartmentsbisma 
Golf Vale by Emaar is a residential development in Emaar South, offering 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments alongside a limited collection of 3-bedroom townhouses. Set within the green surroundings of the community's championship golf course, the development combines contemporary architecture with open fairway views and landscaped outdoor spaces.

The development comprises 262 residences, including 117 one-bedroom apartments, 117 two-bedroom apartments, 22 three-bedroom apartments and six three-bedroom townhouses. Homes range from 672 sq ft to 2,816 sq ft, giving buyers a choice from compact one-bedroom layouts through to larger family homes.

Inside, Golf Vale takes a clean and understated approach. Warm wood, textured stone, metal and glass are paired with minimalist architecture and open layouts, creating bright living spaces with a strong connection to the surrounding greenery. Large windows bring natural light into the homes and frame views across the golf course.

Residents have access to an infinity-edge swimming pool, kids' pool, indoor and outdoor gyms, indoor and outdoor yoga areas, padel court, BBQ area and kids' play area. The wider Emaar South community is centred around an 18-hole championship golf course and includes retail, education, healthcare, hotels and recreational facilities.

Golf Vale is located in Emaar South, approximately 5 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport, 10 minutes from Expo City Dubai, 30 minutes from Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa, and 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport.

faqs.q: What Is Lux Villa Dubai?
faqs.a: LUX Villa Dubai is a luxury real estate advisory and portfolio showcasing curated villas, townhouses, and premier off-plan opportunities across Dubai's most prestigious neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Who Is The Developer Behind Lux Villa Dubai?
faqs.a: We partner directly with leading developers including Emaar, Nakheel, Meraas, Sobha, and Damac to bring you verified, tier-one properties with developer-direct pricing.

faqs.q: Where Is Lux Villa Dubai Located?
faqs.a: Our flagship properties span prime Dubai locations including Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Hills Estate, Emirates Hills, The Valley, and Emaar South.

faqs.q: What Types Of Properties Are Available In Lux Villa Dubai?
faqs.a: We specialize exclusively in luxury standalone villas, modern semi-detached homes, waterfront townhouses, and signature branded estates.

faqs.q: Is Lux Villa Dubai A Good Investment Opportunity?
faqs.a: Yes, our properties are curated for strong capital appreciation and attractive rental yields (typically 6% - 8%+ gross yields) in zero capital gains tax jurisdictions.

faqs.q: Does Lux Villa Dubai Have Government Or Authority Backing?
faqs.a: All advertised projects are 100% compliant and registered with the Dubai Land Department (DLD) and the Real Estate Regulatory Agency (RERA), with secure escrow accounts.
